intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra signs a sentry roster and hands it on. Her hand stays out a moment longer than the roster does.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “The sentries can manage their own shifts. Several have done this longer than I have been alive.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “One of them corrected my salute when I was nine. He was right.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “So you’re not going to check it again?”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I am not going to check it again.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She looks in the direction the roster went.

options.labelText: “The man who fixed your salute can handle a roster. Walk with me?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She walks with you. She only looks back once.

options.labelText: “If it’s bugging you, just check. I always double-check before shipping.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She checks. It is perfect. Across the way, the oldest sentry watches her check it.

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “He used to look at my salute like that.”
